LESSON: WRITING 12.4.1 GUIDED WRITING

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade two
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.4: Writing 12.4.1 Guided Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 12.4.1 Guided Writing under Strand 12. It is aligned with the Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development (KICD) CBC design.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 12.4.1 Guided Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Creativity and imagination is enhanced as the learner draws and names pictures of objects related to the theme.

Values:
Unity is enhanced as the learner works collaboratively with peers to describe the objects they have drawn.

Link to

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life Skills- (effective communication) is enhanced as the learner writes correct sentences to describe objects in the pictures.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Writing correctly is necessary in all learning areas.

Pictures, digital devices, assistive technology such as universal cuffs/wrist braces/arm braces, weighted pencil/pen grips, page-turners, adapted

Other Related Service Providers: Resource person, speech therapist, Learner support assistance, Occupational Therapist, Physiotherapist.
